urls.rationale: PRA §82002 'administrative action' — definitional anchor used in Ch. 6's lobbying-activity scope.
PRA §82026 'legislative action' — definitional anchor used in Ch. 6's lobbying-activity scope.
PRA §82037 'legislative official' — defines the officials in scope for Ch. 6 lobbying contacts.
PRA §82038 'legislative committee' — definitional anchor for Ch. 6.
PRA §82038.5 'lobbying coalition' — definitional anchor referenced by Ch. 6 registration rules.
PRA §82039 'lobbyist' — the core definition Ch. 6 registration applies to.
PRA §82039.5 'lobbying firm' — central category subject to Ch. 6 registration.
PRA §82045 'person' — definitional anchor used throughout Ch. 6.
PRA §82047 'state agency' — definitional anchor used in Ch. 6 lobbying-target scope.
PRA §82048 'state candidate' / 'state agency official' — referenced by Ch. 6 contact and gift rules.

notes: Narrowed to the 10 definitional anchors Ch. 6 actually invokes (lobbyist, lobbying firm, lobbying coalition, administrative action, legislative action, legislative official, legislative committee, state agency, state candidate/agency official, person). Same selection as CA 2015 — no new lobbying-specific definitions added between 2015 and 2025. Ch. 2 is a definitions chapter with 80+ sections; including all would over-fetch with no extraction benefit.
